name: @opencraw/azure-host
description: A deployable Azure Functions app serving OpenCraw over HTTP (Durable Functions) with the recipe-authoring MCP endpoint.

scripts.build: node -e "const ts=require('typescript'),p=require('node:path'),c=ts.getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile('tsconfig.app.json',{},{...ts.sys,onUnRecoverableConfigFileDiagnostic:d=>{throw new Error(ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' '))}});require('esbuild').buildSync({entryPoints:[...new Set(['src/main.ts',...c.fileNames].map(f=>p.resolve(f)))],outdir:'dist',platform:'node',format:'esm',sourcemap:true,tsconfig:'tsconfig.app.json'})" && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');for(const[i,g,o,w]of[['src/assets','**/*','dist/assets',0]])for(const f of fs.globSync(g,{cwd:i})){const s=p.join(i,f),d=p.join(o,f);if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){if(w)fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true})}else{fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}"
